# mintalib

Minimal technical analysis library for Python, implemented in Cython.

This site is rendered HTML for humans. The markdown sources below are
better suited for LLM consumption.

## API reference

- [mintalib](https://furechan.github.io/mintalib/reference/index.md): Minimal technical analysis library for Python
- [mintalib.core](https://furechan.github.io/mintalib/reference/core.md): Calculation routines implemented in cython
- [mintalib.functions](https://furechan.github.io/mintalib/reference/functions.md): Calculation functions for technical analysis indicators
- [mintalib.indicators](https://furechan.github.io/mintalib/reference/indicators.md): Indicators offer a composable interface where a calculation routine is bound with its parameters
- [mintalib.expressions](https://furechan.github.io/mintalib/reference/expressions.md): Polars Expression Factory Methods

## Guides

- [overview](https://furechan.github.io/mintalib/index.md): the three interfaces and their example notebooks
